title: jobvacancy · USE (hosts, containers, data stores)
description: Utilisation, saturation, errors of hosts, containers, Postgres, Redis, River and backups (TZ OPS-04).

panels.title: CPU utilisation
panels.description: Busy share of all cores. TZ §3: < 70 % at 300 RPS; alert above 85 % for 15 m.

panels.title: Load per core (saturation)
panels.description: 5-minute load average divided by cores. Above 1 means work is queueing for CPU.

panels.title: Memory utilisation
panels.description: 1 − MemAvailable / MemTotal. Alert above 92 %.

panels.title: Disk used
panels.description: Per filesystem. Alert above 80 % (warning) and 90 % (critical).

panels.title: Disk busy (I/O utilisation)
panels.description: Share of time the device had I/O in flight. Near 100 % = disk-bound.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Physical interfaces only.

panels.title: CPU by service
panels.description: Cores used by each compose service (1 = one full core).

panels.title: Memory by service
panels.description: Working set (what the OOM killer counts) per compose service. Limits: docker-compose.prod.yml.

panels.title: Postgres
panels.description: Exporter can reach Postgres.

panels.title: Connections used
panels.description: Open backends over max_connections (200). Alert above 80 %.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of block reads served from shared_buffers. Below 99 % on a hot OLTP set: raise shared_buffers or fix a scan.

panels.title: WAL archive age
panels.description: Seconds since the last WAL segment reached offsite S3 (RPO). archive_timeout is 60 s; alert at 15 min.

panels.title: Last full backup
panels.description: Age of the newest successful wal-g full backup (daily 21:00 UTC). Alert at 26 h.

panels.title: Backup size
panels.description: Compressed size of the newest full backup.

panels.title: Connections by state
panels.description: idle in transaction for long = a leaked transaction (idle_in_transaction_session_timeout 10 s).

panels.title: Transactions / s
panels.description: Commits and rollbacks on the app database.

panels.title: WAL archiver
panels.description: WAL segments shipped to offsite S3 per interval. Any failed = WalArchiveFailing alert.

panels.title: Heaviest queries (pg_stat_statements)
panels.description: Where the database spends its time. Parameters are normalised ($1), no user data.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (queryid) (rate(pg_stat_statements_seconds_total{datname="jobvacancy"}[15m])) * on(queryid) group_left(query) max by (queryid, query) (pg_stat_statements_query_id))

panels.title: Deadlocks, conflicts, temp files
panels.description: Errors and spills: temp files mean a sort or hash exceeded work_mem (16 MB).

panels.title: Redis memory used
panels.description: redis-cache evicts (allkeys-lru); redis-state never evicts (noeviction): writes fail when it is full.

panels.title: Redis memory / maxmemory
panels.description: Alert RedisStateMemoryHigh above 85 % for redis-state.

panels.title: Redis ops / s and evictions
panels.description: Evictions on redis-cache are normal under pressure; on redis-state they must be zero.

panels.title: DB pool in use
panels.description: Acquired / max per process pool (api 20, worker 35). Alert above 90 % for 5 m.

panels.title: River jobs waiting / running
panels.description: available = waiting for a worker. Alert RiverQueueBacklog above 1000 for 5 m.

panels.title: River queue wait (oldest runnable job)
panels.description: Queue latency. critical queue carries OTP e-mails: seconds matter there.

panels.title: River jobs finalized (5 m)
panels.description: Throughput by final state. discarded = retries exhausted (RiverJobsDiscarded alert).
